Every other recorded head in this repository is read by somebody who chose to read it. A bound that cannot measure its input must not refuse: making every build on a machine whose <t2/> is unreadable impossible stops all work to prevent a hypothetical. So an unmeasurable free space says so on stderr and lets the build run, and only a measured-and-below refuses. <t3/> lifts it.

en: Every train of open pull requests — a group joined by confirmed dependencies: a base branch that is another open pull request's head, or a `Stacked on #N` / `Depends on #N` line in the body — in landing order. Per link: number, title, author, head and base branch, head commit, the forge's page and checks, disposition, lane, reasons, next action, required-check state and every check on the head, relation to master with how far behind it is and whether it carries master, the prepared head under refs/prep/<n> with whether it is the head the forge serves (pushed) or not yet (pending), its position and depth, whether its turn has come, what it stands on and what it carries, its queue rank and whether a cycle catches it. Per train: roots, tops, the next link the order allows, the edges (STACKED_ON or DEPENDS_ON, satisfied when the link below landed), and the pull requests beneath it that are no longer open. Beside them the prepared heads no train holds, the tallies and the queue's diagnostics. Read from the recorded observation, the queue `majordomus prs status` prints and the local refs: it fetches, pushes and moves nothing. `observed: false` with the reason when this checkout has recorded no observation.
cs: Každý train otevřených pull requestů — skupina spojená potvrzenými závislostmi: base branch, která je headem jiného otevřeného pull requestu, nebo řádek `Stacked on #N` / `Depends on #N` v těle — v pořadí přistání. Pro každý článek: číslo, název, autor, head a base branch, head commit, stránka a kontroly na forge, dispozice, lane, důvody, další akce, stav požadovaných kontrol a každá kontrola na headu, vztah k masteru s tím, jak moc za ním zaostává a zda master obsahuje, připravený head pod refs/prep/<n> a zda je to head, který forge poskytuje (pushed), nebo ještě ne (pending), jeho pozice a hloubka, zda přišla jeho řada, na čem stojí a co nese, jeho pořadí ve frontě a zda ho zachytí cyklus. en: An issue and a milestone read as work to be done rather than as metadata: what a person authored, where the plan graph puts it, what happened to it locally, where its external projection stands, and whether a worker may start it — with the origin of every value on the value. Nothing here writes anything, which is what makes a user-authored GitHub value safe from it.
cs: Úkol a milník čtené jako práce k vykonání, nikoli jako metadata: co člověk napsal, kam je staví graf plánu, co se s nimi lokálně stalo, v jakém stavu je jejich externí projekce a zda je worker smí začít — s původem každé hodnoty přímo u hodnoty. Nic z toho není druhý model projektu: záznamy jsou kanonické, status a graf patří `plan`, branche a commity patří `trace`, slovník připravenosti zpřesňuje tři kanonické stavy, aniž by kterýkoli nahrazoval, a projekce na GitHub zůstává věcí `scripts/github-sync`. One worker per source, four at once in all, above the executor's own cache and single flight. execute is unchanged and exact. ui::source asks for readings; an answer carries its standing (age, current/stale/pending, refreshing); a source line says a reading's age once it is older than five seconds and says when it predates the last change; a line whose reading is catching up carries data-catching-up and the page's script reads the screen again after <n2/> s, doubling to <n3/> s, until none is left. The first reader of the UI starts one background pass over SCREENS and PANELS. MAJORDOMUS_CAPABILITY_CACHE=off makes a reading run its handler; MAJORDOMUS_READING_PATIENCE_MS sets the patience, and wait makes every read exact.
